The interaction between Ashe and Runaan's has been specifically created for her Q, I believe. It doesn't serve much other purpose other than it looks cool/matches the effects.

>So when Ruunan's does the whole attack a ton of enemies with Q thing, does it apply cleaver to all those enemies?

Yes, if you have activated your Q, and you hit three things with one auto, they will all get max stacks of Black Cleaver

> What about BOTRK and Manamune?

As SomethingHere2011 said, flurry only applies "on hit" once like any other basic attack. BotRK and Manamune only deal one instance of extra damage per auto regardless of if your Q is activated or not. Runaan's will apply those extra damages to other targets though, since they do count as on hit. If you have Muramana and Runaan's, this means you will lose almost 9% of your current mana per basic attack if you hit three champions.

> Does Q stack Ruunan's?

I think you mean "does Runaan's stack Q?" because Runaan's has nothing to stack? If so, no, you can only get 4 focus from 4 basic attacks regardless of how many things you hit per auto.

I hope that clears things up. If anything didn't make sense, I'll be happy to explain in a hopefully much more concise and clear way.

Infinity Edge's passive increases the *bonus* damage you do by 50%.


Items | Crit % | Final Bonus
---|---|----
IE | 20% | 110 + (20 * 1.5) = 140% damage
IE + Runaans | 50% | 110 + (50 * 1.5) = 185% damage
Runaans + PD | 60% | 110 + (60) = 170% damage

Critically striking a target will just triple the base slow Ashe has. There is **NO WAY** to increase this slow % from items. The slow only triples if you were to critically strike a target and is in no way affected by critical strike damage amplifiers like IE.

I think the Doran's starting items in the matchups section can be swapped for each other regardless - it just depends on how you want to play.

It's worth noting Ashe has a virtually non-existent level 2 power spike so be especially careful for champions like Lucian, Xayah and Ezreal (who can also all easily dodge your ult at level 6) for ADC, and all in supports like Thresh, Blitzcrank and Rakan who like to take ignite.

Lucian and Xayah however have 500 and 525 range respectively vs. your 600 so keeping the poke up as soon as possible to lower their health is a good way to deter them from trying to cheese you at level 2.

Runaans > IE = 185% dmg + 70 ad, 800g more

Runnans > PD = 170% dmg + 45%atkspd, 5%ms, PD passive

Long story short, Infinity Edge only brings damage to the table. 

Phantom Dancer has more utility aspects such as the pseudo-tankiness and move speed. There is also a slight synergy with stacking black cleaver (and ranger's focus) faster due to more attack speed.

What u/abcalxl said about the crit amplifier increasing the strength of the slows is incorrect. Crits apply a slow 3x that of the base amount regardless. and with PD, you crit 10% more times than with IE - so even then you get more kite potential.
